source: PostHog $ai_generation events, tasks linkedin_draft + linkedin_critique, pulled 2026-10-16
tick_filter: even UTC hours (social-generate runs 17 */2 * * *), excluding 04/10/22 UTC which overlap the content-pipeline cron that uses the same task names; ticks with >= 10 calls
caveat: no per-run trace id exists, so one clock hour = one social-generate run (one A/B pair of drafts)
query: WITH t AS (SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS tick, count() AS calls, countIf(properties.$ai_is_error = true) AS errors, sum(toFloat(properties.$ai_input_tokens)) AS in_tok, sum(toFloat(properties.$ai_output_tokens)) AS out_tok, sum(toFloat(properties.$ai_total_cost_usd)) AS usd, uniq(properties.$ai_model) AS models FROM events WHERE event='$ai_generation' AND properties.task IN ('linkedin_draft','linkedin_critique') AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-02 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-16 00:00:00') AND toHour(timestamp) % 2 = 0 AND toHour(timestamp) NOT IN (4, 10, 22) GROUP BY tick HAVING calls >= 10) SELECT count(), median(calls), avg(calls), median(errors), sum(errors)/sum(calls), median(in_tok), median(out_tok), median(in_tok+out_tok), median(usd), sum(usd), median(models) FROM t
